verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for payment gateways, since some gateway and orchestration products ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only Checkout.com's hosted platform: the Unified Payments API, the Hosted Payment Page, and the vendor-hosted MCP endpoints. The client SDKs and plugins connect to that hosted service, and nothing in the pack shows a self-hostable or on-prem version of the core product.
